**Acid Rain:**
Acid rain refers to any precipitation (rain, snow, fog) that is unusually acidic due to the presence of dissolved industrial pollutants, primarily sulfur dioxide ($\text{SO}_2$) and nitrogen oxides ($\text{NO}_x$). 

* **Formation:**
  $$\text{SO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{H}_2\text{SO}_3 \xrightarrow{\text{O}_2} \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$$
  $$2\text{NO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{HNO}_3 + \text{HNO}_2$$
* **Effects:** Lowers the pH of lakes and soils (harming aquatic life and vegetation), corrodes buildings and historical monuments (marble cancer: $\text{CaCO}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 \rightarrow \text{CaSO}_4 + \text{H}_2\text{O} + \text{CO}_2$), and leaches toxic heavy metals into water supplies.
